meta.name: genomic-intelligence
meta.description: Predict regulatory features, gene structure, and expression directly from DNA sequence using Genomic Intelligence's hosted transformer DNA language models — no local GPU or model weights. Six tasks over a REST API and a hosted MCP server (keyless public demo): promoter regions, splice donor/acceptor sites, enhancer activity, chromatin state, sequence-to-expression (log TPM), and de-novo gene annotation, plus a composite find-genes-then-predict-expression workflow. Use when the user has a gene symbol, a genomic region, or a DNA/FASTA sequence and wants any of these predictions, mentions Genomic Intelligence, genomicintelligence.ai, api.genomicintelligence.ai, or mcp.genomicintelligence.ai.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline_en: Predict regulatory features and gene expression from DNA sequences

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可调用 Genomic Intelligence 的托管 DNA 模型，根据基因符号、基因组区域或 DNA/FASTA 序列预测启动子、剪接位点、增强子活性、染色质状态、表达量（log TPM）和基因注释，并返回结构化结果。
howto.when: 当用户给出基因符号、基因组区域或 DNA/FASTA 序列并请求相关预测，或提到 Genomic Intelligence、genomicintelligence.ai 等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我预测TP53基因的启动子区域。
say.note: 会调用promoter任务，返回启动子区域预测。

say.text: 用K562细胞预测HBB基因的表达水平。
注释这段DNA序列中的基因。
say.note: 会调用annotation任务，异步返回转录本注释。

howto.what_en: Claude uses GI's hosted DNA models to predict promoters, splice sites, enhancers, chromatin, expression (log TPM), and gene annotation from a gene symbol, region, or FASTA, returning structured results.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user provides a gene symbol, genomic region, or DNA/FASTA sequence and asks for one of these predictions, or mentions Genomic Intelligence, genomicintelligence.ai, etc.

say_en.text: Predict the promoter region of the TP53 gene.
say_en.note: Calls the promoter task and returns a prediction.

say_en.text: Predict HBB expression in K562 cells.
say_en.note: Calls expression; requires a TSS-centered 9,198 bp window.

say_en.text: Annotate genes in this DNA sequence.
say_en.note: Calls annotation and returns transcript predictions asynchronously.
